messages:
anya: Starting a small v2 rollout to EU today — 0% -> 10% over 10m, slowpush to 25% over 45m after safety checks. Change window ends 03:30 UTC. Please watch EU latency and 4xxs.

leo: noted. enabling extra probe checks on EU edges for /v2/chat and /v2/generate.

ops: saw a tiny spike in 429s during canary in staging yesterday when header capitalization differed. recommend client pin and a gateway shim if this recurs.

anya: thanks — we'll keep probes. deploybot command: `/deploybot start-rollout --name v2-eu-small --targets eu --phases 10%:10m,25%:45m --slo latency<300ms`

deploy-bot: rollout initiated: v2-eu-small. phase1=10% for 10m. auto-health checks enabled (5m window for 1% error threshold).

dana: quick heads up: adoption shows a bunch of mobile Android 3.3.0 hitting /v2 with mixed-case headers. If the edge normalizer misses them, backends respond 429.

leo: can we add a temporary header-casefold rule scoped to /v2/* on EU edges while we evaluate? low risk.

ops: prefer scoped rule + short client pin to avoid wider rollback. If we apply pin, which versions?

dana: pin mobile-android <=3.3.0 to v1 for 2h should be fine. Most 3.3.1+ have fix.

anya: agreed. I'll apply pin and request Leo to push shim. Commands: `/deploybot pin-client --client mobile-android --version <=3.3.0 --route v1 --until 7365439300` and `/deploybot apply-edge-rule --scope EU --rule header-casefold --path /v2/* --ttl 120m`

deploy-bot: client pin queued: mobile-android <=3.3.0 -> v1 until 7365439300. Edge rule request submitted.

release-bot: FYI added release-notes entry: "EU: temporary client pin for Android <=3.3.0; header casefolding shim enabled on /v2 to mitigate 429s. Monitor for rollback triggers."

leo: pushing shim to staging now. test plan: 5k reqs with UA mobile-android/3.3.0 and mixed header casing. will verify no 429s at edge and no backend regressions. 10m test.

ops: if staging shows >0.5% 429s after shim, abort and pin more aggressively. Otherwise promote to EU prod in a rolling 5m canary.

anya: timeline: staging test in 3m, then prod shim in 15m if green. Rollout hold active until we confirm metrics.

dana: also tagging SDK team — they should push a patch note and nudge customers on 3.3.0 to update.

leo: staging looks good (0.02% 429s in 10m with mixed headers). promoting shim to EU prod with 5m monitoring.

deploy-bot: edge rule applied to EU /v2/*: header-casefold active. Monitoring window started (5m).

ops: monitoring: 0.1% 429s in first 5m, latency unchanged. hold release at 10% for now and proceed to phase2 per rollout plan.

anya: moving to 25% per plan. keeping client pin in place until 2h out. ops, if anything regresses, trigger rollback using `/deploybot rollback --name v2-eu-small --target v1` and notify #release-war-room.

dana: confirming SDK note posted. We'll follow up with a security announcement if customers request.

anya: summary: pin applied for mobile-android <=3.3.0 (2h), header-casefold shim scoped to EU /v2 applied, rollout progressed to phase2. No rollback needed at this time. Thanks team.
